\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \tfrac{1}{2}\Bigl(\min_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} I(s,t) + \max_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} I(s,t)\Bigr)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input channel value
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output channel value
- \(S_{xy}\): The window around pixel (x, y)

S_xy is the size by size window around (x, y). The output is the mean of the first and last values of the sorted window. It uses only these two values, so a single extreme value moves the result by half of its distance.
